title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Justin Kruit…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field plugin up to version 6.1.4. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
